metadata.name: Source-Backed Compiled Diagnostic Rules
metadata.scope: Research-only Brown Spot and Leaf Blast phenotype coverage
metadata.non_invention_statement: These records compile existing source-backed phenotype statements into conservative diagnostic conjunctions. They do not introduce new scientific evidence or promote runtime state.

rules.condition_text: lesion is on leaf blade AND lesion is oval AND necrosis is present AND lesion has chlorotic halo

conclusion.raw_text: Evidence supports diagnosis of Brown Spot

validation.requirement: Validate the compiled phenotype conjunction against local Brown Spot images and expert labels before any state promotion.

provenance.citation: Mew, T. W., Hibino, H., Savary, S., Vera Cruz, C. M., Opulencia, R., and Hettel, G. P., eds. 2018. Rice Diseases: Biology and Selected Management Practices. Los Baños, Philippines: International Rice Research Institute. PDF e-book.
original_extracted_values: Category=Diagnostic; IF=lesion is on leaf blade and is oval and necrotic; THEN=lesion is surrounded by chlorotic halo; Entities=leaf blade, lesion, chlorotic halo; Values=oval, necrotic; Derivation=DIRECT_DIAGNOSTIC_TRANSFORMATION; Evidence Strength=typical phenotype; Scope=rice leaves
provenance.compilation_basis: The existing Brown Spot-specific diagnostic record directly links leaf-blade, oval, necrotic lesions to a chlorotic halo. The compiled rule conservatively requires both the source condition and its phenotype outcome before diagnostic scoring.

conditions.raw_text: lesion center is gray OR lesion center is white

rules.condition_text: lesion is spindle shaped AND (lesion center is gray OR lesion center is white) AND lesion margin is brown

conclusion.raw_text: Evidence supports diagnosis of Leaf Blast

validation.requirement: Validate the compiled lesion-shape and color conjunction against local Leaf Blast images and expert labels before any state promotion.

provenance.citation: Mew, T. W., Hibino, H., Savary, S., Vera Cruz, C. M., Opulencia, R., and Hettel, G. P., eds. 2018. Rice Diseases: Biology and Selected Management Practices. Los Baños, Philippines: International Rice Research Institute. PDF e-book.
original_extracted_values: Category=Lesion Identification; IF=Rice leaf is infected by the blast fungus; THEN=Leaf blast is seen as elliptical spots resembling a spindle shape; Entities=Rice leaf; blast lesion shape; Values=Spindle shape; elliptical spots; Derivation=DIRECT_DIAGNOSTIC_TRANSFORMATION; Scope=LEAF_BLAST_SPECIFIC

Category=Lesion Identification; IF=Leaf blast spot is present; THEN=Center of spot is grayish or whitish and margin is brown or reddish-brown; Entities=Lesion center color; lesion margin color; Values=Grayish or whitish; brown or reddish-brown; Derivation=DIRECT_DIAGNOSTIC_TRANSFORMATION; Scope=LEAF_BLAST_SPECIFIC
provenance.compilation_basis: Two existing Leaf-Blast-specific lesion-identification records jointly provide spindle lesion shape and gray/white center with brown/reddish-brown margin. Their circular prerequisites are discarded; all observable phenotype outputs are required as a conservative conjunction.
